_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Cart
slots.help: The TIC-80 cart: a .tic file, or a .png cart (a picture with the cart inside, as tic80.com offers them).

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the cart has saved (its pmem memory, 1 KB) at the start, for a project that begins from a saved game: a file as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with nothing saved.
slots.nameHelp: a save file is identified by its extension, .pmem.
